source_context:
2026-10-06 Lichess OH prototype harmonyos-next at 3427b720583498e9e1f1980b9aaf6b9097f2daca. GPL-3.0 root and engine component license inspected; no implementation copied. Source/diff only; no build, dependency resolution, emulator/device, OAuth provider, Stockfish execution or push delivery tests. Author device claims in upstream issue https://github.com/lichess-org/mobile/issues/3278 are external reports, not curator verification. Primary OAuth reference https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc8252.html reviewed for external user agents, public clients, PKCE and redirect handling. Listener-before-launch, native mailbox, explicit cancellation and single-settlement recommendations correct observed races; source does not fully implement them. Binary presence does not establish reproducible builds or all engine flavors.
